title: Убери от неё руки  (Take Your Hands Off Her)

segments.t: To hide Artyom's awful cooking from her partners, Eleonora pretends the oversalted dishes are delicious, and her guests politely agree. Feeling invincible after the praise, Artyom grabs Gulya in the kitchen—until Lyova steps forward and demands that he take his hands off her.
А вот и приз для победителя!
Немедленно убери от неё свои руки!
Старик, всё, что я делаю руками, женщинам очень нравится.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Well, how do you like the food?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'come on' before landing on 'food'.
'You know, it was magnificent!' Notice how Russian expresses 'you' and 'magnificently' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Eleonora answers right away.
'Yes, I liked it very much too.' Eleonora anchors the line on 'yes', while 'pleased' completes the thought.
А вот и приз для победителя!
'And here is the prize for the winner!' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'winner' without extra filler words.
'What are you doing tonight?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'what' before landing on 'in the evening'. Lyova answers right away.
'Take your hands off!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'to remove' before landing on 'hands'.
Немедленно убери от неё свои руки!
'Immediately take your hands off her!' The meaning hinges on 'immediately' working together with 'hands' in spoken Russian.
'She does not like that.' Notice how Russian expresses 'to her' and 'pleases' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Denis answers right away.
Старик, всё, что я делаю руками, женщинам очень нравится.
'Old man, everything I do with my hands women like very much.' Denis brings out the contrast between 'old man' and 'everything' in a few short words.
'I said, take your hands off!' Notice how Russian expresses 'I' and 'hands' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'I demand that you apologize to the girl!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'girl'. Denis answers right away.

'Listen, this is over the line.' In Russian, the idea of 'listen' flows naturally into 'too much' without extra filler words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
А вот и приз для победителя!
Немедленно убери от неё свои руки!
Старик, всё, что я делаю руками, женщинам очень нравится.
And that finishes the confrontation in the kitchen. Listen for Lyova's firm commands to take his hands off her and apologize to the girl immediately. See you in the next scene.
